project.name: Placeholder Mixed-Use Building
project.role: Architectural Designer — design development to construction documents
project.description: A four-storey mixed-use building with ground-floor workshops and residential units above, arranged around a central circulation core.

parts.name: Foundation
parts.summary: Reinforced concrete raft with a perimeter thickening below the facade line.

parts.name: Floor Slabs
parts.summary: Post-tensioned flat slabs on a 7.5 m grid, with edge details coordinated with the facade.

parts.name: Circulation Core
parts.summary: Stair and lift core providing lateral stability.

parts.name: Facade
parts.summary: Rainscreen facade of fibre-cement panels, set out and numbered with Dynamo.

parts.name: Roof
parts.summary: Inverted warm roof with a planted terrace and a perimeter parapet.
